verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a GPU accelerator with a supporting software stack (ROCm, drivers, Kubernetes operators, schedulers). Acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers and uses their tools is an AI agent or application role, not something a GPU accelerator would ship, so the axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product or its stack consuming MCP servers, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
